Player Impressions:
Hoyos - was beaten relatively easily at times.  the goals were all failures in defense
Jacob - all forward progress he made in the first half disappeared in the 2nd.  
Mihaj - made some good long runs to clear the ball.  ultimately not good enough
Alonso - He was all over the pitch tonight.  most likely intentional.  He positioning disrupted the back line
Báez - overall a pretty good night.  seemed to have been pulled out of his game the later it went
Galoppo - wasn't able to affect the game
Amaro - has more control of midfield than Tristan alone.  But heeds a second player near him 
Muyumba - progressed the ball a few times.  underwhelming
Almirón - moves the ball forward well, runs like the dickens.  Can no longer do anythign int he final 3rd
Embolo - invisible today when we needed him most.  only had 1 shot.  i can't remember it
Fortune - invisible on both offense and defense

Miranchuk - was not able to create a spark when he entered
Sanchez - helped stabilize midfield.  Got the ball forward.  But entered too late
Picault - had a spark.  He could have made a difference 10 min earlier
Santos - made a nuisance of himself.  Again didn't have enough time

Tata - absolutely waited too long to make changes.  The team was tiring and lost tactics.  They needed a change for 10+ minutes.
